sentiment.rationale: The document shows strong Q4 2025 results with global comparable sales up 5.7% and U.S. comps up 6.8%, but forward guidance is not formally raised; management expects 2026 operating margin to expand from 46.9% to mid-to-high 40% range and provides a cautious outlook noting 'the QSR industry environments in the U.S. and across many markets will remain challenging.' The momentum is genuine (positive guest counts, share gains with low-income consumers, loyalty growth), but the lack of a formal guidance raise and explicit caution on the environment keep the score moderately positive rather than strongly bullish.

summary.revenue: Q4 2025 consolidated revenues increased 10% (6% in constant currencies) to $7,009 million. Full year 2025 consolidated revenues increased 4% (2% in constant currencies) to $26,885 million.
summary.eps: Q4 2025 diluted EPS was $3.03, an increase of 8% (5% in constant currencies). Excluding charges, non-GAAP diluted EPS was $3.12, an increase of 10% (7% in constant currencies). Full year 2025 diluted EPS was $11.95, an increase of 5% (4% in constant currencies).
summary.guidance: Management expects 2026 operating margin to be in the mid- to high 40% range and to expand from 46.9% adjusted operating margin in 2025. Net restaurant expansion in 2026 will contribute approximately 2.5% to system-wide sales growth. Capital expenditures expected to be $3.7-$3.9 billion. Full year effective tax rate between 21% and 23%. Foreign currency expected to be a $0.20-$0.30 per share tailwind to 2026 EPS.
summary.margin: Full year 2025 adjusted operating margin was 46.9%. Management expects 2026 operating margin to be in the mid- to high 40% range and to expand from 2025.
key_risks: Challenging QSR industry environment in the U.S. and across many markets expected to continue in 2026.
Severe weather impacts in the U.S. in late January estimated to be about 100 basis points for Q1 2026.
Macroeconomic pressures in China and parts of Latin America.
GLP-1 drug adoption may change consumer behavior (fewer calories, less snacking, less sugary drinks).
Interest expense expected to increase 4%-6% in 2026 due to higher average interest rates.
key_opportunities: Accelerating new restaurant openings: targeting approximately 2,600 gross openings in 2026, on track for 50,000 restaurants by end of 2027.
Loyalty program growth: 210 million 90-day active users, targeting 250 million by end of 2027; loyalty members visit 2.5x more frequently.
Beverage launch under McCafe brand in 2026, building on successful test that exceeded expectations.
Best Burger rollout in over 85 markets, on track for global coverage by end of 2026.
Chicken category share growth: targeting at least 1 percentage point market share increase by end of 2026 vs. December 2023.
Digital and technology investments (AI-enabled tools, common tech stack) to improve speed and operational consistency.
Category management structure (beef, beverages, chicken) to accelerate innovation and execution speed.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management expresses confidence in the strategy and ability to outperform, stating 'we remain confident in our strategy and our ability to outperform our competitors in any operating environment' and 'we believe that we are well positioned to deliver solid results in 2026.'

review_flags.reason: The score of 0.25 reflects genuine operational momentum (positive guest counts, share gains, loyalty growth) but no formal guidance raise. A reviewer may want to assess whether the cautious language on the challenging environment should pull the score lower, or whether the strong Q4 beat and confident forward language justify a higher score.
